title: Date, time & language
blurb: Wrong clock, time zone, date format, language.

remedies.title: Switch between 12-hour and 24-hour clock
remedies.why: Clock format follows the region settings.

steps.text: Settings › Time & language › Language & region › Regional format › Change formats › Short time.
System Settings › General › Date & Time › 24-hour time.

remedies.title: Show a second time zone clock
remedies.why: Handy when working with people in other time zones.

steps.text: Control Panel › Date and Time › Additional Clocks; Outlook can also show two time zones in the calendar.
Add a World Clock widget, or show two time zones in Calendar › Settings › Advanced.

remedies.title: Language keeps switching while I type
remedies.why: A shortcut (Alt+Shift, Ctrl+Shift, Windows+Space or Control+Space) switches layouts when pressed by accident.

steps.text: Turn off or change the switching shortcut: Settings › Time & language › Typing › Advanced keyboard settings › Input language hot keys.
Change the shortcut in Keyboard › Keyboard Shortcuts › Input Sources.
